newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids unchanged to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids unchanged to higher.

text.p: Bids for dark northern spring and white wheat were unchanged to higher and farmer sales were slow, grain dealers in the northern U.S. grain belt said Friday.
One Minneapolis dealer said "we had a run of country movement yesterday" but farmer sales had slowed considerably by Friday.
"The (spring wheat) price was up a little bit this morning and I thought that we might buy a little wheat but we didn't," a merchandiser in Washington state said.
MGE December spring wheat closed up 1/2 cent at $4.06-3/4 and December white wheat ended unchanged at $4.04.
In export news, Egypt said it was seeking 50,000 tonnes of U.S. soft red or soft white winter wheat for loading in the second half of November.
